name: Juniper: A Scrapbooking Adventure
storyline:
Discover three vibrant islands full of eccentric characters, hidden secrets, and unexpected oddities. Jet-pack, jump, and wander through cozy landscapes at your own pace — no timer, no pressure, just curiosity and charm around every corner.

Chat with islanders, help them with their problems, and receive delightful gifts to add to your collection. Off the beaten path, you'll find secret areas, mysterious puzzles, and surprises tucked away for the most curious explorers.
summary: A cozy adventure-platformer featuring several small but dense "open-world" islands. Jet around, photographing oddities, befriending eccentric locals, and personalising your scrapbook. Use your camera to uncover hidden secrets, and place objects in your scrapbook to influence the world.
